# Toolset `chats`

Chats: messages, participants, files, read counters.

**14 tools.** Mutations require an explicit `confirm=true` argument; `Auth` marks tools that need an hh.ru token.

| Tool | Operation | Auth | Confirm | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- |
| `create_chat_file_upload_link` | `POST /common/chats/files/upload_links` | yes | yes | Create a one-time upload link for a chat file attachment. Upload the file with a multipart POST (field 'file') to the returned URL, then send the message with the received file_upload_id (see send_chat_message). Check get_chat_file_conditions first. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `create_chat_without_vacancy` | `POST /common/chats/without_vacancy` | yes | yes | Get an existing chat or create a new one bound to a resume without a specific vacancy (resume_hash is required, an optional first_message opens the conversation). Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `delete_chat_message` | `DELETE /common/chats/{chat_id}/messages/{message_id}` | yes | yes | Delete your own message from a chat. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `get_chat_file_conditions` | `GET /common/chats/files/conditions` | yes | – | Get conditions for files attached to chat messages: allowed formats, size limits and other constraints. |
| `get_chat_participants` | `GET /common/chats/{chat_id}/participants` | yes | – | List participants of the chat: the applicant and employer managers involved in the conversation. |
| `get_unread_counters` | `GET /common/chats/counters/unread` | yes | – | Get the number of unread chats for the current user (total and with new messages). |
| `leave_chat` | `PUT /common/chats/{chat_id}/leave` | yes | yes | Leave the given chat. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `list_chat_messages` | `GET /common/chats/{chat_id}/messages` | yes | – | List messages of a chat, starting from start_message_id in the given order (next or prev) with a limit (default 10). |
| `list_chats` | `GET /common/chats` | yes | – | List chats of the current user (applicant or employer) with pagination and filters: unread only, with text messages, by vacancy status or explicit vacancy ids. |
| `mark_chat_message_read` | `PUT /common/chats/{chat_id}/message/{message_id}/read` | yes | yes | Mark the message as the last viewed one in the chat (updates unread counters). Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `send_chat_message` | `POST /common/chats/{chat_id}/messages` | yes | yes | Send a message to a chat: either a text message ({"text": "..."}) or a file ({"file_upload_id": "..."} from create_chat_file_upload_link). Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `set_chat_write_possibility` | `PUT /common/chats/{chat_id}/write_possibility` | yes | yes | Enable or disable the applicant's right to write messages in the chat (employer side; applicant_write_possibility is sent as a query parameter). Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `update_chat_message` | `PUT /common/chats/{chat_id}/messages/{message_id}` | yes | yes | Edit the text of your own message in a chat. Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
| `update_chat_participants` | `PUT /common/chats/{chat_id}/participants` | yes | yes | Add an employer manager to the chat (body: manager id). Mutation: requires confirm=True. |
